answer: Identity activation costs a verifiable compute puzzle seeded by the epoch, roughly one minute per key, and the solution is checked before any answer is accepted. Spinning up 300 aliases means 300 minutes of real compute each epoch, which prices a farm out of profit while a single honest agent barely notices. The pigment test is the live device, the jetty test is the locked stake, and the pulse test is the graded history no template can fake.
